section.content: 一种半导体集成电路器件，其上安装有恒流电路，包括允许第1恒定电流流动的第1恒流源101；允许与第1恒流有不同大小的第2恒定电流流动的第2恒流源102；用第1恒定电流与第2恒定电流之差确定的第3恒定电流作恒流源，所述恒流电路中用于储存电荷的电容器、基准电压发生器电路和电压比较器电路相互连接，用所述恒定电路获得的极小恒定电流将电荷储存于电容器中，用电压比较器电路比较电容器的端子电压和基准电压发生器电路的输出电压。

A semiconductor integrated circuit device has a 1st constant current source 101 which can supply a 1st constant current and a 2nd constant current source 102 which can supply a 2nd constant current having a value different from the 1st constant current, and a constant current circuit which uses a 3rd constant current determined by the difference between the 1st constant current and 2nd constant current as a constant source current is constituted. Further, a capacitor for charge accumulation, a reference voltage generating circuit, and a voltage comparing circuit are connected to this constant current circuit, electric charges are accumulated in the capacitor with the extremely small and constant current obtained by the constant current circuit, and the voltage comparing circuit compares the terminal voltage across the capacitor with the output voltage of the reference voltage generating circuit.

Semiconductor integrated circuitThe present invention relates to the constant-current circuit made with semiconductor device, the semiconductor device of the constant-current circuit of the minimum constant current that can obtain high precision high stability particularly is installed on it.The invention still further relates to the timing circuit made from semiconductor device, and be particularly related to timing circuit that the extremely long constant time signal that can obtain high precision high stability is installed on it and cheap semiconductor device.

Up to now, for example, with MIS (MOS) when FET makes constant circuit, the constant current amount of determining with constant-current circuit shown in Figure 11 (a) with Charge Storage in capacitor.

Note, the example of MOSFET will be described in this specification, that is, and with the MOSFET that places the silicon oxide film insulating barrier between metal gate electrode and the Semiconductor substrate typical case as MISFET.

Two p-type MOSFET 807 and 808 constitute electric current mirror circuit 803, and p-type MOS-FET807 is connected with n-type MOSFET 801, and p-type MOSFET 808 is connected with the capacitor 802 of store charge.

Because the grid of n-type MOSFET 801 adds constant bias voltage, therefore, n-type MOSFET801 is as constant current device.

So the constant current of being determined by n-type MOSFET 801 makes capacitor 802 store charges.

And the constant-current circuit in Figure 11 (b) example illustrated is connected voltage comparator circuit and pedestal generator with capacitor in Figure 11 (a) example illustrated.In the example, when reseting signal and become " L ", electric charge begins to be stored in the capacitor 802 simultaneously.Voltage between the reference voltage that pedestal generator 804 produces and the exit of capacitor 802 compares with voltage comparator circuit 805, obtains constant time signal thus.

But, in Figure 11 (a), with minimum constant current (for example 1nA following electric current) with Charge Storage in capacitor the time, promptly, when figuring for extremely long time signal (1 second according to appointment), the electricity that should greatly reduce to constitute the semiconductor device of the constant-current source among Figure 11 (a) is led.Since the adverse effect of leakage current etc., the extremely unsettled defective that can cause its current value itself to become.

And, when constituting constant-current source with MOSFET, attempt obtains constant current with the channel current of MOSFET, and this just need be defined as the channel width of MOSFET minimum mechanical dimension, and the channel length that significantly extends, or obviously increase the size of the capacitor of store charge.

For example, among Figure 11 (b), time signal T represents with following formula (1):

T=(CV Ref)/I ConstIn the formula, C-is the static capacity of the capacitor 802 of store charge.

Vref-is the output voltage of pedestal generator circuit 804.

I Const-be channel current value as the n-type MOSFET 801 of constant current device.

Therefore, when the capacitance of capacitor 802 is 100pf, the output voltage of standard capacitance box circuit 804 is under the situation of 1V, seek out 1 second time signal, then needs the I that equation (1) is determined ConstBecome 100pA.

If the channel current with MOSFET obtains time signal T, then size can increase greatly, and leakage current can bring adverse effect etc. to time signal T.Therefore, time signal T is difficult to be obtained by stable electric current.

In order to obtain long-time signal, the time signal that might of short duration maintenance obtains by circuit shown in Figure 11 (b), and with its distribution.But this just needs to produce the circuit and the distributor circuit (dividercircuit) of repeating signal, thereby large-scale circuit occurred.

Therefore, in the conventional semiconductor device shown in Figure 11 (a) and Figure 11 (b),, want that be unpractical with constant current with Charge Storage in capacitor in order to obtain the long time signal.And this can make price improve greatly.

The objective of the invention is in order to overcome above-mentioned defective, and propose following scheme.

The 1st scheme is a kind of constant-current circuit that is made of semiconductor device, it comprises the 1st constant-current source of the 1st constant current that flows, the 2nd constant-current source of mobile the 2nd constant current, the 1st constant-current source and the 2nd constant-current source are connected in series, the 1st constant current is different with the 2nd constant current, and this constant-current circuit output is by the 3rd constant current of the difference decision of the 1st constant current and the 2nd constant current.

The 2nd scheme is the constant-current circuit that is made of semiconductor device described in the 1st scheme, wherein, the 1st constant-current source and the 2nd constant-current source are connected in parallel to each other by electric current mirror circuit, constitute electric current mirror circuit by two semiconductor device with at least one control end and two main electrode tips, the control end that it can control two semiconductor device of current value that flow out from control end joins mutually altogether, a main electrode in two main electrode tips of each semiconductor device joins mutually altogether, and another main electrode tip is connected with the 2nd constant-current source with the 1st constant-current source respectively, node by the 2nd constant-current source and electric current mirror circuit flows out electric current, or electric current inflow node constitutes the 3rd constant current.

The 3rd scheme is that wherein, MOSFET constitutes constant-current circuit, constitutes the 1st and the 2nd constant-current source with depletion type MISFET as constant-current circuit as described in the 1st scheme, and each source electrode of the gate electrode and its of depletion type MISFET is added with identical bias potential.

The 4th scheme is that wherein, MOSFET constitutes constant-current circuit, constitutes the 1st and the 2nd constant-current source with depletion type MISFET as constant-current circuit as described in the 2nd scheme, and each source electrode of the gate electrode and its of depletion type MISFET is added with identical bias potential.

The 5th scheme is as the described constant-current circuit of the 2nd scheme, wherein, constitutes constant current circuit with MOSFET, constitutes the described the 1st and the 2nd constant-current source with enhancement mode MOSFET, for the Control current value, adds constant voltage for its gate electrode.

The 6th scheme is that wherein, being used in same plane has the MISFET of a plurality of channel regions of different impurities concentration to constitute the 1st and the 2nd constant-current source as constant-current circuit as described in the 1st to the 5th scheme.

The 7th scheme is as the described constant-current circuit of the 6th scheme, wherein, constitutes the 1st and the 2nd constant-current source with two MISFET that have the impurities concentration distribution in identical actual channel length and channel width and the channel region to differ from one another each other.

The 8th scheme is as the described semiconductor device of the 1st to 5 scheme, wherein, constitutes described the 1st constant-current source and the 2nd constant-current source with the MOSFET with different channel lengths.

The 9th scheme is as the described semiconductor device of the 8th scheme, and wherein, in the MOSFET of formation the described the 1st and the 2nd constant-current source, the impurities concentration distribution in the channel region is identical, actual channel length difference.

The 10th scheme is a kind of timing circuit, wherein constant-current circuit is connected with voltage comparator circuit with capacitor, the standard capacitance box circuit of store charge, the constant current of determining with constant-current circuit with Charge Storage in capacitor, compare the reference voltage of capacitor exit voltage and the generation of pedestal generator circuit with voltage comparator circuit, produce constant time signal thus.

The 11st scheme is a kind of constant-current circuit that comprises in the timing circuit, wherein, the 1st constant-current source and the 2nd constant-current source interconnect by electric current mirror circuit, the 1st constant-current source can flow through constant current, the 2nd constant-current source can flow through the different constant current of constant current that flows through with the 1st constant-current source, the node of the 2nd constant-current source and electric current mirror circuit is as output in the constant-current circuit, in order to export an output signal, the capacitor of store charge is connected to the voltage comparator circuit that the output of constant-current circuit and benchmark voltage and capacitor exit voltage are used, be provided with regularly at the output of described constant-current circuit and reset MISFET, have with the drain junction area junction diode of the same area of regularly reseting MISFET and be connected on the node of the 1st constant-current source and current mirror type current.

The 12nd scheme is as time circuit as described in the 10th or 11 schemes, wherein, be provided with at the output of constant-current circuit and regularly reset MISFET, the actual channel length of MISFET and channel width are same as regularly and reset MISFET, and the MISFET that is off-state when timer moves is connected on the node of the 1st constant-current source and electric current mirror circuit.
